newsitem.title: KUWAIT: KNPC refining capacity up to 890,000 bpd in Jan.
newsitem.headline: KNPC refining capacity up to 890,000 bpd in Jan.

text.p: State-owned oil refiner Kuwait National Petroleum Co (KNPC) said its refining capacity will rise to 890,000 barrels per day (bpd) from 852,000 bpd in January, a newspaper reported on Sunday.

"The Mina al-Shuaiba refinery will be operated with its full refining capacity as it was before the vicious Iraqi occupation of the country in middle of next month (January)," al-Anba newspaper said in a report based on remarks by a KNPC official.
"This will increase the refinery's capacity to 195,000 bpd making the refining capacity of Kuwait's refineries 890,000 bpd," it said.
Shuaiba currently processes 160,000 bpd, KNPC has said.
Most of the Gulf state's oil production and refining facilities were damaged during the 1990-91 Iraqi occupation of Kuwait.
Mina al-Ahmadi refinery processes 440,000 bpd and Mina Abdulla refinery processes some 250,000 bpd, said the agency.

KNPC, which runs Kuwait's three local refineries, is the refining arm of the Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) which oversees the oil sector. OPEC member Kuwait has a crude production quota of 2.0 million bpd.
